approaches.name: integrated social protection IT modules and beneficiary tracking systems
approaches.description: Links UBK, Social Contract, youth employment and migrant modules through electronic data exchanges and tracks beneficiaries' labor market outcomes after placement. Practices: employment information system adjusted to track beneficiaries' labor market trajectories after job placement; labor migrant registry integrated with Labor Market Information System; electronic data exchanges across social protection IT modules.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: post-programme labor trajectory tracking in the employment information system | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: First, the information system will be adjusted to monitor beneficiaries even after they complete the job experience opportunity to track their labor market trajectories.

extra_evidence.text: To achieve these objectives, the subcomponent will support the development, implementation, and integration of a registry of prospective and returning labor migrants from the Kyrgyz Republic.
The registry will collect detailed information on both prospective and returning migrants to provide relevant information about them to public employment services to support this specific population.

The implementation of the migrant registry and its links with the Labor Market Information System (LMIS) will allow to refer migrant individuals to support interventions provided by the public employment agency or Page 22 of 61 The World Bank Strengthening Social Assistance and Labor Market Programs Project (P179024) other entities and tailored to their specific needs, such as intermediation services, orientation programs, or skill training, among others.
This subcomponent will ensure smooth and protected technical implementation of the new IT architecture and help establish electronic data exchanges to strengthen delivery systems at the local level.

The new IT architecture will be developed under subcomponents 1.2 (Improved UBK methodology and beneficiary selection module of social assistance IT system), 2.1 (Social Contract module of social Page 23 of 61 The World Bank Strengthening Social Assistance and Labor Market Programs Project (P179024) assistance IT system), 2.2 (Youth Employment module of the IT system of the labor market), and 2.3 (Registry of Migrants module of the IT system of the labor market).

category.rationale: Technological: the adjusted information system is the tracking mechanism

sector.rationale: Tracks social protection beneficiaries' labor market outcomes, core social protection service delivery.
